title: Frank Critzer, Nazi agent killed at Giant Rock

tellings.quote: So uh this this structure under the rock where George Vanessa lived used to be owned by a Nazi called Frank Croitzer.

plain: A room dug under Giant Rock, a huge boulder in the California desert where a man named George Van Tassel later lived, is said to have once belonged to a Nazi named Frank Critzer, who was killed there. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show, citing the book Closer Encounters. In his telling, the site has a hidden Nazi past from before Van Tassel moved in.
